event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.title: Pokémon GO Gameplay and Quality-of-Life Updates
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.titleTr: Pokémon GO oynanış ve kullanım kolaylığı güncellemeleri
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.titleDe: Verbesserungen an Gameplay und Bedienung in Pokémon GO
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.titleEs: Mejoras de jugabilidad y uso en Pokémon GO
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.titleFr: Améliorations du jeu et du confort d’utilisation dans Pokémon GO
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.titleIt: Miglioramenti al gioco e alla facilità d’uso di Pokémon GO
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.note: Published October 8, 2026. These are ongoing gameplay changes, not a limited-time event.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.noteTr: 8 Ekim 2026'da duyuruldu. Bunlar süreli bir etkinlik değil, kalıcı oynanış değişiklikleri.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.noteDe: Veröffentlicht am 8. Oktober 2026. Dauerhafte Änderungen am Spiel, kein zeitlich begrenztes Event.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.noteEs: Publicado el 8 de octubre de 2026. Son cambios permanentes, no un evento temporal.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.noteFr: Annonce du 8 octobre 2026. Il s’agit d’améliorations durables, pas d’un événement à durée limitée.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.noteIt: Annuncio dell’8 ottobre 2026. Sono modifiche permanenti, non un evento a tempo.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.summary: Zygarde Cells found on Routes are awarded at Route completion. Transfers of 100% IV Pokémon now show a confirmation warning. The map, Compass/Weather icon and Community Ambassador meetup check-in were also updated.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.summaryTr: Rotalarda bulunan Zygarde Hücreleri artık rota tamamlandığında veriliyor. %100 IV Pokémon transferinde onay uyarısı çıkıyor. Harita, pusula/hava durumu simgesi ve topluluk buluşmalarına giriş işlemi de yenilendi.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.summaryDe: Zygarde-Zellen von Routen gibt es nun beim Abschluss. Vor dem Verschicken von Pokémon mit 100 % IV erscheint eine Bestätigung. Karte, Kompass/Wetter-Symbol und Check-in bei Community-Treffen wurden ebenfalls verbessert.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.summaryEs: Las Células de Zygarde de las rutas se entregan al terminarlas. Ahora aparece una confirmación al transferir Pokémon con IV del 100 %. También hay mejoras en el mapa, el icono de brújula/tiempo y el registro en encuentros comunitarios.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.summaryFr: Les Cellules de Zygarde trouvées sur une Route sont remises à la fin du parcours. Un avertissement apparaît avant de transférer des Pokémon aux IV parfaits. La carte, l’icône boussole/météo et les inscriptions aux rencontres communautaires ont aussi été améliorées.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.summaryIt: Le Cellule di Zygarde trovate lungo i percorsi vengono assegnate al termine. Il trasferimento di Pokémon con IV al 100 % richiede una conferma. Migliorati anche mappa, icona bussola/meteo e check-in agli incontri della community.
event-pgo-gameplay-update-oct-2026.sourceNotes: Official October 8 gameplay/quality-of-life announcement. Publication date is not an event window.

event-halloween-2026-part-2.title: Halloween 2026 Part II
event-halloween-2026-part-2.note: November 1, 10:00 a.m. to November 5, 8:00 p.m., local time.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.noteTr: 1 Kasım saat 10.00'dan 5 Kasım saat 20.00'ye kadar (yerel saat).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.noteEs: Del 1 de noviembre a las 10:00 al 5 de noviembre a las 20:00 (hora local).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.noteFr: Du 1er novembre à 10 h au 5 novembre à 20 h (heure locale).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.noteIt: Dal 1° novembre alle 10:00 al 5 novembre alle 20:00 (ora locale).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.summary: Shiny Greavard debuts. Greavard, Litwick, costumed Rowlet and other event Pokémon appear in the wild. Mega Sableye gains access to the new Super Max Mega Level.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.summaryTr: Shiny Greavard ilk kez geliyor. Doğada Greavard, Litwick, kostümlü Rowlet ve başka etkinlik Pokémon'ları çıkacak. Mega Sableye için yeni Super Max Mega Seviyesi açılacak.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.summaryDe: Schillerndes Greavard erscheint erstmals. Greavard, Litwick und Rowlet mit Kostüm können in der Wildnis auftauchen. Für Mega-Zobiris wird das neue Super-Max-Mega-Level verfügbar.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.summaryEs: Debuta Greavard variocolor. Greavard, Litwick y Rowlet disfrazado aparecerán en estado salvaje. Mega-Sableye podrá alcanzar el nuevo nivel mega Supermáximo.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.summaryFr: Greavard chromatique fait ses débuts. Greavard, Litwick et Rowlet costumé pourront apparaître à l'état sauvage. Méga-Ténéfix accédera au nouveau niveau Méga Super Max.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.summaryIt: Debutta Greavard cromatico. Greavard, Litwick e Rowlet in costume appariranno allo stato selvatico. Mega Sableye potrà raggiungere il nuovo livello mega Super Max.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.featuredPokemon: Shiny Greavard debuts; wild encounters include Litwick, costumed Rowlet, Greavard and a possible costumed Gengar.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.featuredPokemonTr: Shiny Greavard ilk kez çıkıyor. Doğada Litwick, kostümlü Rowlet, Greavard ve şanslıysan kostümlü Gengar görülebilir.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.featuredPokemonDe: Schillerndes Greavard erscheint erstmals. Wilde Begegnungen: Litwick, Rowlet mit Kostüm, Greavard und mit Glück Gengar mit Kostüm.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.featuredPokemonEs: Debuta Greavard variocolor. En estado salvaje: Litwick, Rowlet disfrazado, Greavard y, con suerte, Gengar disfrazado.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.featuredPokemonFr: Greavard chromatique fait ses débuts. Dans la nature : Litwick, Rowlet costumé, Greavard et, avec de la chance, Gengar costumé.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.featuredPokemonIt: Debutta Greavard cromatico. In natura: Litwick, Rowlet in costume, Greavard e, con un po' di fortuna, Gengar in costume.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.bonuses: GO Pass milestone bonuses: Rank 10 unlocks 2× Catch Candy (3× with Deluxe); Rank 20 unlocks 2× Catch Stardust (3× with Deluxe). Bonuses require reaching the ranks.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.bonusesTr: GO Pass kademe ödülleri: 10. seviyede 2 kat yakalama Şekeri (Deluxe ile 3 kat); 20. seviyede 2 kat yakalama Yıldız Tozu (Deluxe ile 3 kat). Bonuslar için ilgili seviyelere ulaşmak gerekir.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.bonusesDe: GO-Pass-Meilensteine: Rang 10 schaltet 2× Fangbonbons frei (3× mit Deluxe); Rang 20 schaltet 2× Fang-Sternenstaub frei (3× mit Deluxe). Die Ränge müssen erreicht werden.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.bonusesEs: Bonos del Pase de GO: rango 10, el doble de Caramelos por captura (triple con Deluxe); rango 20, el doble de Polvos Estelares por captura (triple con Deluxe). Hay que alcanzar cada rango.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.bonusesFr: Bonus du Passe GO : rang 10, Bonbons de capture ×2 (×3 avec Deluxe) ; rang 20, Poussières Étoile de capture ×2 (×3 avec Deluxe). Il faut atteindre ces rangs.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.bonusesIt: Bonus del Pass GO: al grado 10, caramelle da cattura ×2 (×3 con Deluxe); al grado 20, polvere di stelle da cattura ×2 (×3 con Deluxe). Occorre raggiungere i gradi indicati.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.raids: One-star raids: Pikachu wearing a hat and capelet, and Sinistea wearing a bow (both can be Shiny).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.raidsTr: Bir yıldızlı akınlar: şapkalı ve pelerinli Pikachu ile fiyonklu Sinistea (ikisinin de Shiny'si çıkabilir).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.raidsDe: Raid-Stufe 1: Pikachu mit Hut und Umhang sowie Sinistea mit Schleife (beide können schillernd sein).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.raidsEs: Incursiones de una estrella: Pikachu con sombrero y capa y Sinistea con lazo (ambos pueden salir variocolor).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.raidsFr: Raids de niveau 1 : Pikachu avec chapeau et cape, Sinistea avec nœud (tous deux peuvent être chromatiques).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.raidsIt: Raid di livello 1: Pikachu con cappello e mantello e Sinistea con fiocco (entrambi possono essere cromatici).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.research: Event-themed Field Research tasks award Pokémon encounters, including Greavard encounters from GO Pass and Field Research tasks.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.researchTr: Etkinlik temalı Alan Araştırması görevleri Pokémon karşılaşmaları veriyor. Greavard, GO Pass ve Alan Araştırması görevlerinden de çıkabiliyor.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.researchDe: Event-Feldforschung bietet Pokémon-Begegnungen. Greavard kann auch durch GO-Pass- und Feldforschungsaufgaben erscheinen.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.researchEs: Las tareas de investigación de campo del evento dan encuentros con Pokémon. Greavard también aparece como recompensa del Pase de GO y de investigación de campo.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.researchFr: Les Études de terrain de l'événement donnent des rencontres Pokémon. Greavard peut aussi être obtenu via le Passe GO et les Études de terrain.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.researchIt: Le ricerche sul campo dell'evento offrono incontri con Pokémon. Greavard si può incontrare anche tramite il Pass GO e le ricerche sul campo.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.eventNotes: GO Pass runs October 27–November 5. Deluxe is a paid upgrade. These dates are separate from the November 1–5 Part II event window.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.eventNotesTr: GO Pass 27 Ekim–5 Kasım arasında geçerli. Deluxe ücretli bir yükseltme. Bu tarihleri 1–5 Kasım'daki 2. Bölüm etkinliğiyle karıştırma.
event-halloween-2026-part-2.eventNotesDe: Der GO-Pass läuft vom 27. Oktober bis 5. November. Deluxe ist kostenpflichtig. Das ist ein anderer Zeitraum als Halloween Teil II (1.–5. November).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.eventNotesEs: El Pase de GO dura del 27 de octubre al 5 de noviembre. Deluxe es de pago. Este periodo es distinto del evento Parte II (1–5 de noviembre).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.eventNotesFr: Le Passe GO se déroule du 27 octobre au 5 novembre. Deluxe est payant. Cette période diffère de l'événement Partie II (du 1er au 5 novembre).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.eventNotesIt: Il Pass GO va dal 27 ottobre al 5 novembre. Deluxe è a pagamento. Questo periodo è diverso da quello dell'evento Parte II (1–5 novembre).
event-halloween-2026-part-2.sourceNotes: Official Pokémon GO Halloween 2026 Part II announcement. Event Nov 1–5; GO Pass Oct 27–Nov 5.

event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.title: Pokémon TCG 30th Celebration Event
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.titleEs: Celebración de los 30 años de Pokémon TCG
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.note: US participating retail locations only, September 27–October 20, 2026 (local time).
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.noteTr: Yalnızca ABD'deki katılımcı mağazalarda, 27 Eylül–20 Ekim 2026 (yerel saat).
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.noteDe: Nur in teilnehmenden US-Geschäften, 27. September bis 20. Oktober 2026 (Ortszeit).
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.noteEs: Solo en tiendas participantes de EE. UU., del 27 de septiembre al 20 de octubre de 2026.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.noteFr: Uniquement dans les magasins participants aux États-Unis, du 27 septembre au 20 octobre 2026.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.noteIt: Solo nei negozi aderenti negli Stati Uniti, dal 27 settembre al 20 ottobre 2026.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.summary: At participating US retail stores, Mega Gengar raids and event-themed Timed Research are available. This is not a global gameplay bonus event.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.summaryTr: ABD'deki katılımcı mağazalarda Mega Gengar akınları ve etkinlik temalı Süreli Araştırmalar var. Küresel oyun bonusu etkinliği değil.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.summaryDe: In teilnehmenden US-Geschäften gibt es Mega-Gengar-Raids und befristete Forschung. Kein weltweites Bonus-Event.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.summaryEs: En tiendas participantes de EE. UU. hay incursiones de Mega Gengar e investigación temporal. No hay bonos globales anunciados.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.summaryFr: Dans les magasins participants aux États-Unis : Méga-Raids avec Méga-Ectoplasma et Étude ponctuelle. Aucun bonus mondial annoncé.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.summaryIt: Nei negozi aderenti negli USA ci sono raid di Mega Gengar e ricerche a tempo. Non sono annunciati bonus globali.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.bonuses: No global XP, Stardust or Raid Pass bonuses announced. Redeem a Pokémon GO gift-card code purchased from Target, GameStop or Best Buy (US stores or websites) at the Pokémon GO Web Store, Sep 27–Oct 31, 2026: Gengar Knit Cap avatar item. One per account; existing owners get an item of equal value.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.bonusesTr: Genel TP, Yıldız Tozu veya Akın Bileti bonusu duyurulmadı. Target, GameStop veya Best Buy'dan (ABD mağazaları veya siteleri) alınan Pokémon GO hediye kartı kodunu 27 Eylül–31 Ekim 2026'da Pokémon GO Web Mağazası'nda kullanın: Gengar örgü şapkası avatar öğesi. Hesap başına bir kez; zaten sahip olanlara eşdeğer başka bir öğe verilir.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.bonusesDe: Keine globalen EP-, Sternenstaub- oder Raid-Pass-Boni angekündigt. Pokémon GO-Geschenkkartencodes von Target, GameStop oder Best Buy (US-Filialen/Websites) vom 27.9.–31.10.2026 im Pokémon GO-Webstore einlösen: Gengar-Mütze für den Avatar. Einmal pro Konto; wer sie bereits besitzt, erhält einen gleichwertigen Gegenstand.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.bonusesEs: No hay bonos globales anunciados de PX, Polvos Estrella ni pases de incursión. Canjea en la tienda web de Pokémon GO un código de tarjeta regalo comprado en Target, GameStop o Best Buy (tiendas o webs de EE. UU.) del 27 sep. al 31 oct. de 2026: gorro de Gengar para el avatar. Uno por cuenta; quienes ya lo tengan reciben otro artículo del mismo valor.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.bonusesFr: Aucun bonus mondial de PX, de Poussière Étoile ni de Pass de Raid annoncé. Utilisez sur la boutique Web Pokémon GO un code de carte cadeau acheté chez Target, GameStop ou Best Buy (magasins/sites américains) du 27 sept. au 31 oct. 2026 : bonnet Ectoplasma pour l'avatar. Une fois par compte ; objet de même valeur si déjà possédé.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.bonusesIt: Nessun bonus globale di PE, polvere di stelle o biglietti raid annunciato. Riscatta sul negozio web di Pokémon GO un codice di carta regalo acquistato da Target, GameStop o Best Buy (negozi/siti USA) dal 27 set. al 31 ott. 2026: berretto Gengar per l'avatar. Uno per account; chi lo possiede già riceve un oggetto di pari valore.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.raids: Mega Gengar appears in Mega Raids only at participating US retailers; a Shiny Gengar encounter is possible.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.raidsTr: Mega Gengar, yalnızca ABD'deki katılımcı mağazaların Mega Akınlarında bulunabilir; Parlak Gengar ile karşılaşma ihtimali vardır.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.raidsDe: Mega Gengar erscheint bei Mega-Raids in teilnehmenden US-Geschäften; eine Begegnung mit einem schillernden Gengar ist möglich.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.raidsEs: Mega Gengar aparece en mega incursiones en tiendas participantes de EE. UU.; es posible encontrar un Gengar variocolor.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.raidsFr: Méga-Ectoplasma apparaît en Méga-Raids dans les magasins participants aux États-Unis ; un Ectoplasma chromatique est possible.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.raidsIt: Mega Gengar appare nei mega raid dei negozi aderenti negli USA; è possibile incontrare un Gengar cromatico.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.research: Open Pokémon GO at a participating US store to obtain event Timed Research by October 20 at 10 p.m. local time. Complete and claim rewards by November 20 at 10 p.m. local time.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.researchTr: ABD'deki katılımcı mağazada oyunu açarak Süreli Araştırmayı 20 Ekim saat 22.00'ye kadar alın. Görevleri tamamlayıp ödülleri 20 Kasım saat 22.00'ye kadar toplayın (yerel saat).
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.researchDe: Befristete Forschung bis 20. Oktober, 22 Uhr Ortszeit, in einem teilnehmenden US-Geschäft abholen; Belohnungen bis 20. November, 22 Uhr einlösen.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.researchEs: Consigue la investigación temporal en una tienda participante de EE. UU. antes del 20 de octubre a las 22:00; reclama las recompensas antes del 20 de noviembre a las 22:00.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.researchFr: Récupérez l'Étude ponctuelle dans un magasin participant aux États-Unis avant le 20 octobre à 22 h ; réclamez les récompenses avant le 20 novembre à 22 h.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.researchIt: Ottieni la ricerca a tempo nei negozi aderenti negli USA entro il 20 ottobre alle 22:00; riscatta le ricompense entro il 20 novembre alle 22:00.
event-pokemon-tcg-30th-celebration.sourceNotes: Verified against official Pokémon GO announcement, 2026-10-08. Retail-only promotion, not global gameplay bonuses.

event-october-communityday2026.title: October 2026 Community Day: Zorua
event-october-communityday2026.titleEs: Día de la Comunidad de octubre de 2026: Zorua
event-october-communityday2026.noteEs: 10 de octubre de 2026, de 14:00 a 17:00 (hora local).
event-october-communityday2026.noteFr: 10 octobre 2026, de 14 h à 17 h (heure locale).
event-october-communityday2026.summary: Zorua appears more often in the wild on October Community Day. Shiny and Special Background Zorua are possible.
event-october-communityday2026.summaryTr: Ekim Topluluk Gününde vahşi doğada daha çok Zorua çıkacak. Parlak ve Özel Arka Planlı Zorua ile karşılaşılabilir.
event-october-communityday2026.summaryDe: Am Community Day erscheint Zorua häufiger in der Wildnis; schillernde Exemplare und besondere Hintergründe sind möglich.
event-october-communityday2026.summaryEs: Zorua aparecerá con más frecuencia en estado salvaje; puede ser variocolor o tener un fondo especial.
event-october-communityday2026.summaryFr: Zorua apparaîtra plus souvent à l'état sauvage ; il pourra être chromatique ou avoir un fond spécial.
event-october-communityday2026.summaryIt: Zorua apparirà più spesso allo stato selvatico; potrebbe essere cromatico o avere uno sfondo speciale.
event-october-communityday2026.bonuses: 3× catch XP, 2× catch Candy and doubled Candy XL chance (level 31+). Incense activated during the event (except Daily Adventure Incense) lasts 3 hours; regular Lures last 1 hour. Zorua is more common at regular Lures from 2–9 p.m. local time. One extra Special Trade and 50% less trade Stardust cost until 9 p.m.
event-october-communityday2026.bonusesTr: Yakalamada 3× TP, 2× Şeker ve 31. seviyeden itibaren 2× Büyük Şeker şansı. Etkinlik sırasında etkinleştirilen Tütsü (Günlük Macera Tütsüsü hariç) 3 saat, normal Yem Modülleri 1 saat sürer. Normal Yem Modüllerinde 14.00–21.00 arası Zorua daha sık çıkar. 21.00'e kadar ek Özel Takas ve %50 daha düşük takas Yıldız Tozu maliyeti vardır.
event-october-communityday2026.bonusesDe: 3× Fang-EP, 2× Fang-Bonbons und doppelte XL-Bonbon-Chance (ab Level 31). Während des Events aktivierter Rauch (außer täglichem Abenteuerrauch) hält 3 Std.; normale Lockmodule halten 1 Std. An normalen Lockmodulen erscheint Zorua von 14–21 Uhr häufiger. Bis 21 Uhr gibt es einen zusätzlichen Spezialtausch und 50 % weniger Sternenstaub-Kosten.
event-october-communityday2026.bonusesEs: 3× PX por captura, 2× Caramelos y doble probabilidad de Caramelos XL (nivel 31+). El Incienso activado durante el evento (excepto el de Aventura Diaria) dura 3 h; los Módulos Cebo normales, 1 h. Zorua aparece más en esos cebos de 14:00 a 21:00. Hasta las 21:00 hay un intercambio especial adicional con un 50 % menos de Polvos Estrella.
event-october-communityday2026.bonusesFr: 3× PX de capture, 2× Bonbons et double chance de Bonbons L (niveau 31+). L'Encens activé pendant l'événement (hors Encens d'aventure quotidienne) dure 3 h ; les Leurres classiques, 1 h. Zorua apparaît plus souvent près de ces Leurres de 14 h à 21 h. Jusqu'à 21 h : un échange spécial de plus et 50 % de Poussière Étoile en moins.
event-october-communityday2026.bonusesIt: 3× PE alla cattura, 2× caramelle e doppia probabilità di caramelle L (livello 31+). L'Aroma attivato durante l'evento (escluso l'Aroma avventura giornaliera) dura 3 ore; i moduli esca normali 1 ora. Zorua appare più spesso presso questi moduli dalle 14:00 alle 21:00. Fino alle 21:00: uno scambio speciale extra e il 50% in meno di polvere di stelle.
event-october-communityday2026.sourceNotes: Official Pokémon GO October Community Day announcement, 2026-10-08.
event-october-communityday2026.featuredPokemon: Zorua appears more often in the wild and can be Shiny or have a Special Background. Evolve during the event or within the featured move window for Zoroark with Sucker Punch.
event-october-communityday2026.featuredPokemonTr: Vahşi doğada daha çok Zorua çıkar; Parlak veya Özel Arka Planlı olabilir. Öne çıkan hareket süresinde evrimleştirilen Zoroark, Ani Yumruk öğrenir.
event-october-communityday2026.featuredPokemonDe: Zorua erscheint häufiger in der Wildnis, auch schillernd oder mit besonderem Hintergrund. Durch Entwicklung während des Events oder bis zu vier Stunden danach kann Zoroark Tiefschlag erlernen.
event-october-communityday2026.featuredPokemonEs: Zorua aparecerá más a menudo en estado salvaje, también variocolor o con fondo especial. Zoroark podrá aprender Golpe Bajo al evolucionar durante el plazo indicado.
event-october-communityday2026.featuredPokemonFr: Zorua apparaîtra plus souvent à l'état sauvage, parfois chromatique ou avec un fond spécial. Zoroark peut apprendre Coup Bas en évoluant pendant la période prévue.
event-october-communityday2026.featuredPokemonIt: Zorua apparirà più spesso allo stato selvatico, anche cromatico o con sfondo speciale. Zoroark può imparare Sbigoattacco evolvendosi nel periodo previsto.
event-october-communityday2026.research: Paid Zorua Community Day Special Research and themed Field Research are available; some reward encounters can feature Zorua with a Special Background.
event-october-communityday2026.researchTr: Ücretli Zorua Topluluk Günü Özel Araştırması ve temalı Alan Araştırmaları var; bazı ödül karşılaşmalarında Özel Arka Planlı Zorua bulunabilir.
event-october-communityday2026.researchDe: Kostenpflichtige Zorua-Spezialforschung und thematische Feldforschung sind verfügbar; einige Begegnungen können einen besonderen Hintergrund haben.
event-october-communityday2026.researchEs: Hay investigación especial de pago e investigaciones de campo de Zorua; algunos encuentros de recompensa pueden tener un fondo especial.
event-october-communityday2026.researchFr: Une Étude spéciale payante et des Études de terrain Zorua sont proposées ; certaines rencontres peuvent avoir un fond spécial.
event-october-communityday2026.researchIt: Sono disponibili una ricerca speciale a pagamento e ricerche sul campo di Zorua; alcuni incontri ricompensa possono avere uno sfondo speciale.

event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.note: Official event window: July 4, 10:00 a.m. to July 6, 2026, 8:00 p.m. local time.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.noteTr: Resmi etkinlik aralığı: 4 Temmuz 10.00 ile 6 Temmuz 2026 20.00 yerel saat.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.featuredPokemon: Gimmighoul with a 10th anniversary coin, cake-hat Pikachu, party-hat Eevee, and party-hat Wurmple.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.featuredPokemonTr: 10. yıl dönümü coinli Gimmighoul, pasta şapkalı Pikachu, parti şapkalı Eevee ve parti şapkalı Wurmple.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.bonuses: 4x catch XP, 4x catch Stardust, event-themed wild Pokémon more likely shiny, and possible special-background Gimmighoul.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.bonusesTr: 4x yakalama XP, 4x yakalama Star Tozu, etkinlik temalı vahşi Pokémonlarda daha yüksek shiny şansı ve özel arka planlı Gimmighoul ihtimali.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.raids: Treat paid research and special-background catches as keep-checks before cleanup.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.raidsTr: Ücretli araştırma ve özel arka planlı yakalamaları temizlikten önce ayrı kontrol et.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.research: Featured evolution moves: Venusaur Frenzy Plant, Charizard Blast Burn, Blastoise Hydro Cannon.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.researchTr: Öne çıkan evrim hareketleri: Venusaur Frenzy Plant, Charizard Blast Burn, Blastoise Hydro Cannon.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.summary: This is a costume, shiny, XP, Stardust, and special-background event. Do not bulk-transfer event catches blindly.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.summaryTr: Bu etkinlik kostüm, shiny, XP, Star Tozu ve özel arka plan odaklı. Etkinlik yakalamalarını topluca göndermeden önce kontrol et.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.prep: Tag costumed, shiny, and special-background catches. Check Gimmighoul separately before any transfer.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.prepTr: Kostümlüleri, shiny'leri ve özel arka planlıları etiketle. Gimmighoul'u transferden önce ayrı kontrol et.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.eventNotes: Check Gimmighoul, costumed Pikachu, costumed Eevee, costumed Wurmple, shiny catches, and special backgrounds before cleanup.
event-10th-anniversary-party-2026.eventNotesTr: Gimmighoul'u, kostümlü Pikachu'yu, kostümlü Eevee'yi, kostümlü Wurmple'ı, shiny yakalamaları ve özel arka planları temizlikten önce kontrol et.

event-road-of-legends-2026.note: Official event window: July 6, 12:01 a.m. to July 10, 2026, 11:59 p.m. local time.
event-road-of-legends-2026.noteTr: Resmi etkinlik aralığı: 6 Temmuz 00.01 ile 10 Temmuz 2026 23.59 yerel saat.
event-road-of-legends-2026.featuredPokemon: Team-hat Pikachu, special-background raid catches, Link Charges, and Incubators all deserve a separate check this week.
event-road-of-legends-2026.featuredPokemonTr: Takım şapkalı Pikachu, özel arka planlı akın yakalamaları, Bağlantı Şarjı ve kuluçka makinelerini bu hafta ayrı kontrol et.
event-road-of-legends-2026.featuredPokemonDe: Pikachu mit Team-Mütze, Raid-Fänge mit besonderem Hintergrund, Link-Ladungen und Brutmaschinen sollten diese Woche getrennt geprüft werden.
event-road-of-legends-2026.featuredPokemonEs: Pikachu con gorra de equipo, capturas de incursión con fondo especial, Cargas de Enlace e incubadoras merecen una revisión aparte esta semana.
event-road-of-legends-2026.featuredPokemonFr: Pikachu avec casquette d’équipe, captures de raid avec arrière-plan spécial, Charges de Lien et incubateurs méritent une vérification séparée cette semaine.
event-road-of-legends-2026.featuredPokemonIt: Pikachu con cappello di squadra, catture raid con sfondo speciale, Cariche Collegamento e incubatrici vanno controllati separatamente questa settimana.
event-road-of-legends-2026.bonuses: GO Fest prep week with no Remote Raid Pass limit through GO Fest, raid bonuses, 1/2 Egg Hatch Distance, and GO Pass rewards.
event-road-of-legends-2026.bonusesTr: Uzak Akın Bileti limiti yok, akın bonusları, yarım yumurta çıkma mesafesi ve GO Bileti ödülleri.
event-road-of-legends-2026.bonusesDe: Kein Limit für Fern-Raid-Pässe, Raid-Boni, halbe Ei-Brutdistanz und GO-Pass-Belohnungen.
event-road-of-legends-2026.bonusesEs: Sin límite de pases de incursión remota, bonus de incursión, mitad de distancia de eclosión y recompensas del Pase GO.
event-road-of-legends-2026.bonusesFr: Aucune limite de Pass de Raid à distance, bonus de raid, distance d’éclosion divisée par deux et récompenses du Passe GO.
event-road-of-legends-2026.bonusesIt: Nessun limite ai biglietti raid da remoto, bonus raid, distanza di schiusa dimezzata e ricompense Pass GO.
event-road-of-legends-2026.raids: Legendary, Ultra Beast, Mega, Primal, and Super Mega raid catches may have special backgrounds during the week.
event-road-of-legends-2026.raidsTr: Efsanevi, Ultra Canavar, Mega, Kadim ve Süper Mega akın yakalamalarında hafta boyunca özel arka plan olabilir.
event-road-of-legends-2026.raidsDe: Legendäre, Ultrabestien-, Mega-, Proto- und Super-Mega-Raid-Fänge können diese Woche besondere Hintergründe haben.
event-road-of-legends-2026.raidsEs: Las capturas de incursiones legendarias, Ultraentes, Mega, Primigenias y Super Mega pueden tener fondos especiales esta semana.
event-road-of-legends-2026.raidsFr: Les captures de raids légendaires, Ultra-Chimères, Méga, Primo et Super Méga peuvent avoir des arrière-plans spéciaux cette semaine.
event-road-of-legends-2026.raidsIt: Le catture da raid leggendari, Ultracreature, Mega, Archeo e Super Mega possono avere sfondi speciali questa settimana.
event-road-of-legends-2026.research: GO Pass: Road of Legends runs through July 12 and includes encounters, candy, Link Charges, Incubators, and raid rewards.
event-road-of-legends-2026.researchTr: GO Bileti: Efsaneler Yolu 12 Temmuz'a kadar sürer; karşılaşmalar, şeker, Bağlantı Şarjı, kuluçka makineleri ve akın ödülleri içerir.
event-road-of-legends-2026.researchDe: Der GO-Pass: Road of Legends läuft bis 12. Juli und enthält Begegnungen, Bonbons, Link-Ladungen, Brutmaschinen und Raid-Belohnungen.
event-road-of-legends-2026.researchEs: El Pase GO: Road of Legends dura hasta el 12 de julio e incluye encuentros, caramelos, Cargas de Enlace, incubadoras y recompensas de incursión.
event-road-of-legends-2026.researchFr: Le Passe GO : Road of Legends dure jusqu’au 12 juillet et comprend rencontres, Bonbons, Charges de Lien, incubateurs et récompenses de raid.
event-road-of-legends-2026.researchIt: Il Pass GO: Road of Legends dura fino al 12 luglio e include incontri, caramelle, Cariche Collegamento, incubatrici e ricompense raid.
event-road-of-legends-2026.summary: This is GO Fest prep: make storage, tag raid catches, and keep special-background or GO Pass reward encounters safe.
event-road-of-legends-2026.summaryTr: Depoda yer aç, akın yakalamalarını etiketle, özel arka planlı veya GO Bileti ödülü karşılaşmalarını güvene al.
event-road-of-legends-2026.prep: Review raid catches separately. Daily Discoveries are paused during Road of Legends and GO Fest Global.
event-road-of-legends-2026.prepTr: Akın yakalamalarını ayrı incele. Günlük Keşifler, Efsaneler Yolu ve GO Fest Küresel boyunca duraklatılır.
event-road-of-legends-2026.prepDe: Raid-Fänge getrennt prüfen. Tägliche Entdeckungen sind während Road of Legends und GO Fest Global pausiert.
event-road-of-legends-2026.prepEs: Revisa las capturas de incursión por separado. Los Descubrimientos Diarios se pausan durante Road of Legends y GO Fest Global.
event-road-of-legends-2026.prepFr: Vérifie séparément les captures de raid. Les Découvertes quotidiennes sont suspendues pendant Road of Legends et le GO Fest Global.
event-road-of-legends-2026.prepIt: Controlla separatamente le catture raid. Le Scoperte giornaliere sono sospese durante Road of Legends e GO Fest Global.
event-road-of-legends-2026.eventNotes: Protect raid catches, team-hat Pikachu, special backgrounds, shiny catches, and GO Pass reward encounters before cleanup.
event-road-of-legends-2026.eventNotesTr: Temizlikten önce akın yakalamalarını, takım şapkalı Pikachu'yu, özel arka planları, Parlak Pokémonları ve GO Bileti ödülü karşılaşmalarını koru.
event-road-of-legends-2026.eventNotesDe: Schütze Raid-Fänge, Pikachu mit Team-Mütze, besondere Hintergründe, Shinys und Begegnungen aus GO-Pass-Belohnungen vor dem Aufräumen.
event-road-of-legends-2026.eventNotesEs: Protege capturas de incursión, Pikachu con gorra de equipo, fondos especiales, shiny y encuentros del Pase GO antes de limpiar.
event-road-of-legends-2026.eventNotesFr: Protège les captures de raid, Pikachu avec casquette d’équipe, arrière-plans spéciaux, shiny et rencontres du Passe GO avant le tri.
event-road-of-legends-2026.eventNotesIt: Proteggi catture raid, Pikachu con cappello di squadra, sfondi speciali, shiny e incontri premio del Pass GO prima della pulizia.

event-go-fest-global-2026.title: Pokémon GO Fest 2026: Global
event-go-fest-global-2026.note: Official event window: July 11–12, 2026, 10:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. local time.
event-go-fest-global-2026.noteTr: Resmi etkinlik aralığı: 11–12 Temmuz 2026, 10.00–19.00 yerel saat.
event-go-fest-global-2026.featuredPokemon: Global GO Fest featuring Mewtwo and Zeraora, with raid, research, shiny, background, and storage prep checks.
event-go-fest-global-2026.featuredPokemonTr: Mewtwo ve Zeraora odaklı küresel GO Fest; akın, araştırma, shiny, arka plan ve depo hazırlığı kontrolleri.
event-go-fest-global-2026.boostedPokemon: Mewtwo, Zeraora, team-hat Pikachu, raid catches, research rewards, and trade candidates.
event-go-fest-global-2026.boostedPokemonTr: Mewtwo, Zeraora, takım şapkalı Pikachu, akın yakalamaları, araştırma ödülleri ve takas adayları.
event-go-fest-global-2026.bonuses: Free for all Trainers during the event weekend, with Special Research, additional bonuses, and increased shiny chance.
event-go-fest-global-2026.bonusesTr: Etkinlik hafta sonu tüm Eğitmenlere ücretsiz; Özel Araştırma, ek bonuslar ve artan shiny şansı içerir.
event-go-fest-global-2026.raids: Review Mewtwo and other raid catches separately for IVs, shiny status, and special backgrounds.
event-go-fest-global-2026.raidsTr: Mewtwo ve diğer akın yakalamalarını IV, shiny durumu ve özel arka plan için ayrı incele.
event-go-fest-global-2026.research: Special Research leads to Zeraora. Do not mix research reward checks with bulk cleanup.
event-go-fest-global-2026.researchTr: Özel Araştırma Zeraora'ya götürür. Araştırma ödülü kontrollerini toplu temizlikle karıştırma.
event-go-fest-global-2026.summary: GO Fest creates many valuable catches quickly. Protect shiny, legendary, mythical, costume, background, raid, and trade candidates first.
event-go-fest-global-2026.summaryTr: GO Fest kısa sürede çok değerli yakalama oluşturur. Önce shiny, efsanevi, özel, kostüm, arka plan, akın ve takas adaylarını koru.
event-go-fest-global-2026.prep: Open storage before the event. After each session, review raid catches and tagged keepers before cleanup.
event-go-fest-global-2026.prepTr: Etkinlikten önce depo aç. Her oturumdan sonra temizlikten önce akın yakalamalarını ve etiketli saklanacakları incele.
event-go-fest-global-2026.eventNotes: Keep shiny, legendary, mythical, costume, special-background, raid, research, and trade candidates before any transfer.
event-go-fest-global-2026.eventNotesTr: Transferden önce shiny, efsanevi, özel, kostüm, özel arka plan, akın, araştırma ve takas adaylarını sakla.
